developers

We are a mix:

  • Jamie is senior and experienced but has only dabbled in R
  • Zach is an applied scientist who uses R, we are creating this in R to be accessible to him, and to demo how he might structure his research project
  • Charles is senior and experienced with extensive R knowledge

data package

We will follow good enough practices for this, but in the context of:

  • This is a lightweight package intended for use in just one analysis.
  • We will favour brevity and accessibility in code, as we are mostly experienced.
  • This is not production grade, we do not need to handle every exception and think of every user error.
  • The intentionality of it being a data package is to make usage smoother in the analysis in blockhole, not submit to CRAN.
  • We love being FAIR, but not exhaustive.
